C1454.title: Parity Wallet Multisig Library Bug Leads to Massive Permanent ETH Freeze
C1454.summary: In November 2017, a self-destruct function vulnerability in the multisig contract library used by Parity Wallet was accidentally triggered, causing approximately 510,000 ETH (worth around $150 million at the time) to be permanently locked in the contract.
